title: Canton Fair Phase 2: What to Do After the Halls Close
description:
Phase 2 of the 140th Canton Fair runs from October 23–27, 2026, focusing on home décor, gifts, and daily-use products across 25,000+ booths and 515,000 square meters of exhibition space.

The halls close at 6pm. If you’re in Guangzhou for the fair, here’s what’s happening after hours:

October 24, 7pm — ASIAPRO Canton Fair Meetup at JoJo’s Riverside (Haizhu). Free, no agenda, no pitches. Buyers, distributors, and importers talking on the Pearl River.

October 24, 7pm — NZGBA Networking Drinks at ATOC Bar (Zhujiang New Town). Free entry, happy hour until 10pm, Kiwi-owned bar in the heart of the city’s after-work district.

Any night — neighborhood restaurants in Haizhu, Yuexiu, or Liwan. The best conversations in Guangzhou don’t happen in hotel lobbies.

GFIC Crew runs regular social events across Guangzhou — food crawls, language exchanges, weekend trips, and meetups that mix business travelers with long-term residents.

Search “GFIC Crew” on X, Instagram, YouTube, Xiaohongshu, or WeChat Official Account. WeChat: DN8117.
